description: LTDS Stage 2 CIM Files is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. The LTDS CIM dataset provides a structured representation of the Long-Term Development Statement (LTDS) using the Common Information Model (CIM), enabling consistent data exchange and network modelling across Distribution Network Operators (DNOs). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Long Term Development Statement (LTDS), Extra High Voltage (EHV), Circuit. The portal shows 2025-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
